correctness_confidence.basis: All four main theorems (Theorems 2.1, 3.1, 4.1, and 5.1), algebraic identities, Walsh-Hadamard character sums, and boundary checks are completely verified with zero unresolved material mathematical or factual objections.

rigor.basis: Self-contained proofs throughout Sections 2-5 with exemplary scope discipline in Section 6 distinguishing machine-checked Lean/Python algebraic kernels from analytic 2-design and Hilbert-space arguments.

novelty.basis: Corrects the flag-Pauli cardinality formula, resolves the even-n analytic gap via a two-orbit self-transpose PPT_n channel G_n, proves Conjecture 4 across the full n-qubit depolarizing family, and introduces the tensor-stable outer spectrahedron O_n.

significance.basis: Substantial structural and quantitative extension of Kitzinger, Eisert, and Kunjwal (2026) yielding exact rational bound-magic witnesses, all even-n >= 4 analytic families, and explicit distillation ceilings; Conjecture 4 is resolved specifically for depolarizing channels.

reproducibility.basis: All analytic derivations are fully self-contained in the PDF and complemented by 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems, 16 zero-float SHA-256 certificates, and 56 adversarial pytest checks.

summary: This manuscript presents four clean, self-contained, and rigorously proved advances directly extending Kitzinger, Eisert, and Kunjwal [9] on multi-qubit bound magic: (1) correcting the n-qubit flag-Pauli set cardinality from 2^{n-1}(2^{n-1}-1) to (2^n-1)(2^{n-1}-1) and deriving the exact Walsh-Hadamard spectrum of F_n, proving the exact odd/even stabilizer witness threshold alpha_max(n) = 3/(2 sqrt(2)) (odd n) vs. 1 (even n) via Z[i] Gauss-sum norm factorization, and exhibiting a rational/dyadic bound-magic witness state in B_3(Q) \ STAB_3; (2) constructing the first analytic even-n bound-magic family for all even n >= 4 via a two-orbit self-transpose PPT_n channel G_n and proving exact 1-uniformity; (3) establishing the exact PPT_n = EB interval [-1/(4^n-1), 1/(2^n+1)] for the n-qubit depolarizing channel D_lambda, proving Conjecture 4 of [9] across the entire depolarizing family, and proving a universal Parseval spectral inequality for all PPT_n channels; and (4) extending Ruskai's octahedral inequality to all T(n) = (4^n-1)4^n/12 anticommuting Pauli triples to construct a tensor-stable, Clifford-covariant outer spectrahedron O_n containing B_n, yielding exact quantitative distillation ceilings for CHSH, |Psi_+>, |T>, and |H>. All mathematical claims, derivations, boundary conditions, figures, and scope distinctions are consistent and verified with zero unresolved material mathematical or factual objections.
strengths: Exact, self-contained, and completely verified proofs across all four main theorems (Theorems 2.1, 3.1, 4.1, and 5.1), with every algebraic identity, Walsh-Hadamard character sum, and boundary check carried out explicitly in the manuscript.

Elegant resolution of the even-n analytic gap from [9] using the Bell-modified target state |+^{n-2}> otimes |Phi^+> with irrational overlap t_n = 2^{-(n-1)/2} and the two-orbit PPT_n channel G_n adapted to the non-trivial stabilizer intersection {I, P_0}, along with an exact proof of 1-uniformity.

Clean proof of the exact odd/even witness threshold alpha_max(n) via Z[i] quadratic Gauss-sum norm factorization, plus an explicit rational-entry witness W_3(3/(2 sqrt(2))) and dyadic unit vector |psi_3> certifying bound magic purely over Q.

Complete proof of Conjecture 4 of [9] on the entire n-qubit depolarizing family using the stabilizer projective 2-design at the upper endpoint lambda_+ = 1/(2^n+1) and the Pauli l_1-norm simplex at the lower endpoint lambda_- = -1/(4^n-1).

Derivation of the multi-qubit Ruskai octahedral inequality on anticommuting Pauli triples, defining a tractable tensor-stable outer spectrahedron O_n that converts Corollary 3 of [9] into tight quantitative distillation ceilings.

Exemplary scope discipline in Section 6, explicitly separating the algebraic, combinatorial, symplectic, and rational-trace kernels verified in Lean/Python from the complex projective 2-design and Hilbert-space arguments proved analytically in Sections 2-5.
weaknesses: Scope limitation relative to [9]: Conjecture 4 of [9] is proved only for the n-qubit depolarizing family D_lambda rather than arbitrary entanglement-breaking n-qubit Pauli channels (as accurately stated in the manuscript).

Minor notation/caption polish (non-material): Figure 1(b)'s caption writes omega_a where the main text uses |psi_a><psi_a|; the proof of Theorem 3.1(2) on p. 7 locally reuses m in c -/+ t_n m (c, m in Q), colliding with m := 2^{n-1} from the theorem statement; and Section 5 uses both |Psi_+> (CHSH magic state) and |Psi^+> (Bell stabilizer state) in close proximity.

Minor citation precision (non-material): In Theorem 4.1(1), the separability-iff-PPT equivalence for the isotropic Choi state is attributed only to [8] (Horodecki-Shor-Ruskai 2003), whereas the isotropic-state separability threshold originates in Horodecki-Horodecki (1999).
strong_novelty_candidates: Exact flag-Pauli cardinality correction (2^n-1)(2^{n-1}-1), Z[i] Gauss-sum odd/even witness threshold, and dyadic rational bound-magic witness in B_3(Q) \ STAB_3.
First analytic even-n bound-magic family for all even n >= 4 via the two-orbit self-transpose PPT_n channel G_n with exact 1-uniformity.
Complete proof of Conjecture 4 on the entire n-qubit depolarizing family and universal Parseval spectral inequality for PPT_n channels.
Multi-qubit Ruskai octahedral outer spectrahedron O_n >= B_n and exact quantitative distillation fidelity ceilings.
